extension.name: EIC Anonymiser
extension.description: Anonymises (does not delete) personal and company data for EIC contacts: names, email, websites (incl. LinkedIn), company name, and the custom fields PIC, SMEDId, Company Domain Name and eulogin. Also scrubs the matching log_ / extended log tables.
extension.comments: Companion to (and independent of) de.systopia.anonymiser. This extension anonymises fields in place instead of deleting the related records.
